clauses.quote: Only permanent unit members are eligible to apply for an unpaid leave (exception: Family Care and Medical Leave).
All leave requests shall carry a statement of recommendation by the immediate supervising administrator with reasons therefore.
clauses.notes: Grammatical subject is inanimate; duty falls on worker.

clauses.quote: All requests shall be considered by the Deputy Superintendent and the Superintendent prior to submitting to the Board of Education.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is management.

clauses.quote: Generally, leaves shall be a minimum of one (1) semester and a maximum of two (2) semesters
clauses.notes: Structural rule defining leave duration parameters.

clauses.quote: and will begin and end on semester dates.
clauses.notes: Dependent clause joined by 'and'; shares subject with preceding clause.

clauses.quote: Unusual circumstances may be considered to waive this requirement (e.g., "year-round school").
clauses.notes: Discretionary clause granting management authority to waive duration limits.

clauses.quote: Upon written request, consideration will be given to extending unpaid leaves to a maximum of two years.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; grants management discretion to extend leave.

clauses.quote: A unit member on unpaid leave must serve at least 75% of the duty days required for that year in order to receive credit for one year's experience.
clauses.subject_text: A unit member on unpaid leave

clauses.quote: At the end of the leave, the District shall make a good faith effort to assign the returning unit member to a position which was held at the time the leave was granted.
Unless circumstances preclude, all leave applications must be submitted ten (10) weeks prior to the beginning of the leave (except for Family Care and Medical Leave).
clauses.notes: Passive construction; duty falls on worker to submit early.

clauses.quote: The unit member on leave must notify the Human Resources Office before March 10 for Traditional Calendar and February 10 for Year-Round school of his/her intention to return to the District at the expiration of the leave or resign from the District.
On semester leaves, the above date shall be November 1 for Traditional Calendar and October 1 for Year-Round school.
After a leave has been approved, the District is under no obligation to return the unit member to service sooner than the ending date of the leave.
clauses.notes: Relief from duty; explicitly negates obligation rather than imposing prohibition.

clauses.quote: No leave shall be recommended unless the Assistant Superintendent, Human Resources, has determined that a competent replacement is available.
